author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a horned figure (open circular head with two horns curling up from its sides) over round-shouldered torso, with a long tail swinging out from the body and curving up to an arrowhead. The head is exactly 8 above the torso top on centerlines (4 visible), with the point under the head the nearest body point; the checker certifies it once the head is two half circles. A first candidate with horns on the head's upper shoulders left the exact gap uncertified (review). The rejected drawing had a heavy blob body and a detached arrow.
omissions: The horns grow from the head's sides rather than its top shoulders (so the head stays two cardinal half circles and the exact 4-unit gap is certified); the torso's legs/hem step is simplified to straight sides.
drawing_plan: Head r5 (14,13) as two half circles; horns cubics from (9,13)/(19,13) to (6,6)/(22,6); torso x 6..22 top y=26 r4 shoulders, open bottom; tail cubic (22,36)-(38,28)-(40,12); arrowhead (34,13)-(40,12)-(42,18).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'user' (head over shoulders); tail cubic with a chevron tip as in 'arrow-up-right'; human proportions from icon_set/references/human_ref/user.svg.
